title: Measures wash off in dishwasher...
text: Measures wash off in dishwasher.... ...and then, what's it good for?  A measuring cup with no discernable measure marks?  I guess you can use it as a soup bowl.  (Did not, for the record, buy thru Amazon, but it is the same product.)  I'm off to buy Pyrex now.

product_metadata.title: Anchor Hocking Fire-King Measuring Cup, Glass, 1-Cup
features: Constructed of sturdy & thick clear glass
Easy to read, red measuring guide
Made by Anchor Hocking in the USA
description: The Fire-King 1-Cup Measuring Cup from Anchor Hocking is constructed of clear, durable, heat-resistant glass which is microwave, oven and dishwasher safe. The sturdy measuring cup features an easy-to-read, red measuring guide for precise liquid measurements when cooking and baking. Proudly made in the USA.
